successCriteria.description: IPolicyService exposes getActivePolicies(asOf: Date): Promise<LeavePolicy[]> and PolicyService implements it.

getActivePolicies returns at most one policy per leaveTypeCode: only rows with status ACTIVE, effectiveFrom <= asOf, and (effectiveTo === null || effectiveTo >= asOf); ties broken by latest effectiveFrom.
getActivePolicies returns an empty array (not null/undefined, no throw) when no policy is active as of the given date.
policy/index.ts exports a createPolicyService() factory returning new PolicyService(new PgLeavePolicyRepository(), new LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository())).

constraints: Do NOT add or modify any IPolicyRepository method — getActivePolicies must reuse the existing findAll(client?) and filter in service code.
getActivePolicies is read-only: it must not open a transaction or forward a PoolClient (no unit-of-work contract for this phase).
Do NOT touch the balance module in this phase; the factory is consumed by balance in Phase 5.
Import LeavePolicyStatus from ./policy.model (already imported in policy.service.ts); do not re-declare or move the enum.
outOfScope: No routes, controllers, or RBAC for the policy module — this phase is service + factory only.
No audit-log writes (GP-002) — getActivePolicies is a read-only enumeration.
No repository method additions or changes to PgLeavePolicyRepository.

entityInvariants.invariant: At most one ACTIVE policy applies per leaveTypeCode as of any given date; when multiple ACTIVE policies overlap for a code, the one with the latest effectiveFrom wins.
LeavePolicyStatus remains a module-local enum (DRAFT | ACTIVE | SUPERSEDED) declared in policy.model.ts; it is not moved to shared/types.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read-only; returns an array (possibly empty) and never throws for an empty result.
Pure wiring factory; no I/O, no error cases.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: getActivePolicies must call the existing IPolicyRepository.findAll(client?) and filter in service code — do not add a repository method.
The factory must wire the exact composition already hand-wired in leave.service.ts: new PolicyService(new PgLeavePolicyRepository(), new LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository())).
LeavePolicyStatus.ACTIVE and the LeavePolicy effectiveFrom/effectiveTo/status fields must match the model exactly (effectiveTo is Date | null).
The factory must import LeaveTypeService/PgLeaveTypeRepository through the leave-type public entry point, not by direct file path.

integrationPoints.why: getBalancesForEmployee will call policyService.getActivePolicies(new Date()) and createPolicyService() — this phase provides both.
createPolicyService wires LeaveTypeService(PgLeaveTypeRepository) — policy owns its leave-type dependency.
